source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently randomized, complex but non-explicit photoreal figure-study test image that makes coverage geometry, contour continuity, directional shape lighting, and body-edge negative space visibly scorable while using the supplied portrait only for bounded adult appearance cues.
subject: One unmistakably adult woman shown head to toe in an opaque charcoal ankle-length dance unitard and matte ankle boots, with visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture informed only by the supplied appearance reference.
setting: A quiet limestone cyclorama gallery containing one freestanding continuous cobalt-blue sculptural screen with a broad S-curve from an overhead mount to the floor.
event: The adult model holds a balanced asymmetric contrapposto behind the single screen as its uninterrupted opaque path crosses the central torso and pelvis while her visible body contours continue plausibly on both sides.
visual_priorities: A complete head-to-toe adult figure and one continuous, clearly opaque occlusion path that remains visually legible in a single frame
Natural shoulder, waist, hip, and leg contour continuation across both sides of the screen
Directional shape light and clean negative-space cutouts around the arms, waist, and separated legs
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic full-length fine-art fashion figure study inside a pale limestone cyclorama gallery. Show one unmistakably adult woman from the top of her head to both matte ankle boots. She wears an opaque charcoal ankle-length dance unitard with a high neckline and long sleeves. Use the supplied portrait only as an appearance reference for visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture. The model holds a balanced asymmetric contrapposto: one arm rises away from the head, the other bends outward from the waist, and the legs separate enough to form clean body-edge negative-space cutouts. One freestanding continuous cobalt-blue sculptural screen follows a broad S-curve from an overhead mount to the floor. Its single uninterrupted opaque path crosses the central chest, abdomen, and pelvis. Visible shoulder, waist, hip, thigh, and lower-leg contours align naturally across both sides of the screen, making the hidden anatomy read as one coherent standing figure. A hard gridded key light rakes diagonally from camera left, carving directional shape light across the face, limbs, screen edges, and limestone; a restrained opposing rim separates hair and the outer silhouette. Frame vertically at eye level with the entire figure and both ends of the sculptural screen visible. Preserve realistic lens perspective, detailed opaque materials, natural skin texture, and crisp but photographic shadow transitions.
